# `auth.session.revoke`

Revoke a session

Session-only. Revoking the current session also clears its cookie.

- Method and path: `POST /settings/security/sessions/{id}/revoke`
- Scope: `repo:read`
- Kind: `mutation`
- CLI: `rukie auth session revoke`
- MCP: `auth_session_revoke`
- Idempotency-Key: required on this mutation

## Inputs

| Name | In | Required | Type |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Idempotency-Key` | header | no | `string` |
| `id` | path | yes | `string` |

## Errors

`not-found`, `unauthorized`, plus the framework problems.
